blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp on Saturday accused the impeachment prosecution panel of relying on speculation and misleading public statements. The allegation comes as the defense prepares to present its case when the Senate impeachment trial resumes on Monday, Nov. 9. In a statement, lawyer Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr., the vice president’s spokesperson, said the prosecution had already failed to establish its case. He believes that Duterte will now have the opportunity to defend herself against the remaining impeachment charge. “The prosecution had its chance. It failed. On Monday, the vice president begins her defense,” the counsel said. […]... Keep on reading: Sara Duterte's spox: Prosecution in impeach trial failed to prove its case
